meta.name: multi-reviewer-patterns
meta.description: Coordinate parallel code reviews across multiple quality dimensions with finding deduplication, severity calibration, and consolidated reporting. Use this skill when organizing multi-reviewer code reviews, calibrating finding severity, or consolidating review results.

copy.tagline: 协调多路并行代码审查，去重并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常组织多人代码审查并需统一汇总反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate parallel code reviews, deduplicate findings, and consolidate results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often organize code review with multiple reviewers and need consolidated feedback.

howto.what: 它会协调多名审查者从安全、性能、架构等维度并行审查代码，合并重复发现、统一严重性分级，然后生成汇总报告。
howto.when: 当你要组织多人/多维度的代码审查、统一严重性分级或合并多份审查结论时触发。

say.text: 为这个PR安排安全、性能、架构三个维度的并行审查。
say.note: Claude 会分配维度并生成合并报告。

say.text: 合并这些审查结果，重复的发现只留一条，严重性取最高。
say.note: 去重后统一严重性分级。

say.text: 生成代码审查报告，按严重性分组并附统计表。
say.note: 输出 Markdown 格式的汇总报告。

howto.what_en: It coordinates multiple reviewers across dimensions like security, performance, and architecture, deduplicates findings, calibrates severity, and produces a consolidated report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when organizing multi-dimensional or multi-reviewer code review, calibrating severity, or consolidating multiple review results.

say_en.text: Arrange parallel reviews for this PR on security, performance, architecture.
say_en.note: Claude assigns dimensions and produces a consolidated report.

say_en.text: Merge these reviews, keep duplicates as one, and use the highest severity.
Generate a code review report grouped by severity with a stats table.
